Intent must match action. control_search requires control_search={candidate,source,settings:{version:local_control_search_v2,method:response or pattern,knots_s,correction_window_s optional,coefficient_limit_n,difference_step_n,initial_radius_n,minimum_radius_n,evaluation_requests,iterations},adaptation_from optional exact parent candidate}. Read candidate parameters before design changes. Lower dimensional local windows are optional; outside selected window inputs remain exactly unchanged. Always evaluate all original constraints. Local response and mathematics are diagnostics, not proofs of global feasibility or structural infeasibility. Read results after experiments and freely choose next action or STOP. All fresh result references are in next research packet observations; cite only nonhistorical ones plus evidence actually used. If search does not pass, preserve best, remaining violations, unresolved hypotheses and a useful next research question. Protected budgets are for reads/selection/STOP. Do not consume them in exploration. This independent study tests JOINT structure/control capability. At least one useful new structure and explicit control adaptation should be tested when legal capacity permits. You select variables and direction from evidence.
